chapters.title: The Beginning
chapters.summary: Adonis awakens in the twilight realm, unaware of the ancient curse stirring beneath the roots.

content.text: It was a day of celebration in the kingdom of Norge, as the great warrior, prince Adonis was coming home with his victorious army. Adonis had won the seventh battle of his life and so far, the greatest one. All the people in the Norge were celebrating his victory over the Swēoland. The Chinese fireworks were blasting through the sky for the welcome of the prince and his army. A crowd was gathered at the gates of Royal Castle, bringing fruits and garlands and fresh, ripe crops from all over the kingdom as a token of love for the courageous warriors. As the cavalry came to the palace, the maids started singing folk songs; the wave of joy was observed among the people. Hugs were exchanged; the crowd was chanting, “All hail, Adonis,” “Adonis, Adonisss.” Prince Adonis, sitting on horseback, came and was glad to see the warm welcome and gave his victory credit to his brave and courageous warriors. A guard came by and whispered in Bjorn’s ear. Bjorn is a skilled warrior and a great friend of the prince. He then came by the prince’s horse and told him that the king wants to meet him. Adonis dismounted the horse and went to the castle.

As the king was lying on his deathbed, he asked, “Where is Adonis, my son?” The servant replied, “The prince will be here soon.” The king was counting the days waiting for his son to return from a year-long battle. King asked the servants, “Why is he taking up so much time? The battle is over already.” Servants assure the king Ares that Adonis is coming soon. King was already dying in wait of his son. One of the ministers came by and said, “He is here.” Adonis was aware of his father’s condition; he came by and sat on the floor near his father’s bed. King was glad to see him. Adonis held King Ares’ palm in his hand and felt cold. Soon he said, “So bad, old man.” King Ares replied, “Ahh, you were not here…”. Adonis told him about how he captured King Zandard of the Swēoland. King Ares remarked, “I think it’s the right time…”. Adonis asked, “For what?” King Ares said, “I am so proud of you; you are a big boy now.” Adonis asked, “So, what?” King Ares said, “Time for releasing me from my duties,” “Time for you to succeed me.” Adonis said with happy tears, “You are not too old, father.” King Ares said, “I can’t___ I know doctors have raised their hands.” Adonis replied, “But father, doctors can’t always be true.” King said, “I had done all good, bad, and none the less great things in my life. Now I want to be one with the almighty”. Adonis was speechless seeing his father’s pain. King Ares was bored with his life and told Adonis that he lived enough.

Adonis stared looking at those doctors in the room and asked them, “Why don’t you do something?”. One of the doctors replied, “It’s almighty’s wish.” Adonis said furiously, “Who is God to take this great soul of King Ares…?”. One of the doctors said, “God is everything there is__, but there is a way”. “A way?” Adonis asked with hope. King said “NO” to the doctors, Adonis insisted. King said, “I would prefer dying.” “But I won’t let you die, father,” said the Adonis. The doctor replied, “There is a way, Elixir__”. Adonis asked, “Elixir, so the rumors are true?”. He asked, “If there is any chance, I would love to take it.” King stopped him, saying, “I don’t want to die taking your life, my son.” “But you're worth more than mine,” Adonis replied. King told him, “No warrior in history ever returned from the voyage of obtaining immortality; they either die or die miserably.” Adonis said hopefully, “But dying in a path of glory is the same as being immortal.” “All those who died seeking glory in immortality were considered fools.” King Ares denied Adonis saying this. King Ares told Adonis, “Let me die my death, son, for death is the ultimate reality.” Adonis asked the doctor, “Where can I find Elixir?”. The doctor told Adonis that “the secret is locked behind the doors of the royal treasury.” Then Adonis sat with his father, eventually making King Ares fall asleep while telling him about the great battle he fought. After the king Ares fell asleep, Adonis went to the treasury and took out the map to the Elixir. He studied the map and came to the conclusion that the secret to immortality is in the deep lava pools inside the ‘Sönghellir cave’ which is located on the island named ‘Isle of Garðar.’ He realized that the way is tough enough to kill an army of thousands. But he has made up his mind to take out the secret of immortality for his father.

Adonis went to his most trusted men and asked them to come with him on his voyage. He told his men that this journey is deadly and they shouldn’t come if they don’t want to. He told Bjorn to make a cavalry unit of the bravest warriors they had. Brave warriors and war heroes appear before him; among them were his close friends Einar and Aksel. A group of fourteen young and courageous men was formed. Adonis planned to start the voyage the same night as the doctor told him to take the secret of immortality as soon as possible because King Ares was in a critical situation. Adonis didn’t want his father to know that he was going for the elixir, so he visited him when King Ares was asleep and put the sacred flower, which he had brought from the great battle, on King Ares’ pillow as the king was asleep. Adonis whispered in his ear, “Goodbye, Father,” as if he were meeting him for the last time. King flipped sides on his bed, considering that something was bugging him. Adonis left his father in sleep and went on to the great journey. Adonis with his most trusted cavalry, with the fastest horses and sharpest blades forged in the hottest furnaces of the Norge. At the midnight hour they left the castle in the frosty cold weather of Norge. The great journey began with enthusiasm and high morale, only to face their next great challenge on the outskirts of the kingdom — 'The Norge Weather’.

poem.title: Song of Rising Sun
stanzas: Voyage of thousand miles, Through snow, brine and pines, Arduous journey to immortality, To Isle of Gardar’s Shrines.
O’ Adonis, son of King Ares, Fighting Evil, devil and furies, He Holds the courage to walk, Alone on the path of glory…

chapters.title: Through The Mourning Sea
chapters.summary: A journey deep into the forbidden thicket where fireflies reveal secret runes.

content.text: It was Full moon, Journey Began with hope, men were chanting godly verses. Travelling through fields of peasants, through meadows of tall grass cavalry with high morale, travelling the beautiful side of Norge. Journey by the river Glomma, the scenery was spectacular the full moon was blooming and reflection of it was seen in the river, black and white horses in cavalry were walking elegantly by the river; majestic trees are at sleep while gusts of wind blowing rhythmically, unpaired nightingales were singing songs in longing. It was an idyllic night no one will ever forget. All the men were travelling to this sacred pat of Norge for first time. The night passed on with long conversations, old stories and memories.

A dawn as spectacular as the night emerged before the cavalry the serene scenery was breathtaking. Bjorn stopped the cavalry to take a break and discuss the map with Adonis. As Bjorn and Einar are most experienced warriors Adonis gave them map to study and plan the journey accordingly. All three men studied the map to Sönghellir cave and Einar noticed that the way goes through Norskahavið sea. Bjorn said “Ah, that Sea__ its always angry…”. Adonis replies “We are missing something too…”. “What?” Einar exclaimed. “The Forest of Dead” replied Adonis. “Is that the Mephisto’s Forest of Dead Army?” Bjorn asked. “Path to Immortality goes through Death” Einar said smirking. Adonis replied “I already told you if you want to come, then only you should come”. Einar said “I hope I achieve Immortality before death”. Bjorn said “we are not going there for our immortality but for King’s”. Einar looked at Bjorn’s face with a look of disappointment. Bjorn knew Einar is having something in his mind but he ignored that and said “so we need to take a big boat at the shore”. “Ah yes, I sent a messenger eagle to our contact on the shore it’s all set there” Adonis replied. Bjorn gathered up the cavalry and explained them the route to the destination and they stared their journey after a sleep.

Two days passed and as the men were moving forward the weather was getting worse all the spectacular scenery was turning into cold and snowy weather of outer Norge climate. Auroras appeared in the sky with the snowy lands beneath legs of tired horses. Men pushing each other’s morale to travel ahead. But the cold was merciless heavy winds started blowing with large gusts of small snow balls. Greatest of warriors were shivering with cold. The will to travel further was slowly diminishing, Adonis was noticing the pain of the men, some of the men were strong enough to bear the pain but not all three men already fell sick to the weather. But the journey has to continue and the word was the shore must be reached in a week thus there was no point in stopping as the king has less time in hand.

Journey continued for another two days covering large distances at noon and taking breaks during nights. Three of the young men had lost their souls to the cold. Others carried their bodies. Men were moving forward with a hope that shore is getting closer and hoping some relief at the villages near shore. Another day passed another two died. Men were losing morale Bjorn gave them a war cry but it wasn’t war against the enemy but nature. Adonis was regretting bringing young men with him and the whole journey itself. Seeing the distant dark horizon Einar said “we are close, I saw the sea…”. Every man felt a sigh of relief they started rushing towards the shore. One of the men said “Why is there no light in village?”. Adonis replied “let’s go there and see”. The cavalry of ten alive and five dead arrived at the village by the shore. Adonis exclaimed “Not a single man can bear this weather they must be inside their shelters”. All the men started searching for the contact on the shore. Bjorn noticed a lantern lit near the very side of the sea and said ‘’Aye Captain, There’s the Light”. Adonis said with relief “Ha it’s the light of hope, our man must be there”.

They moved towards the light found the contact. Adonis gave him gold as a payment for the boat, the man said “you are on wrong time, you won’t be able to make the sail”. Bjorn said “But we have to”. Einar said “We are on a journey of no return”. Adonis interrupted him and said “If any man from the cavalry wants to abandon the mission, he is free to stay in the village till the weather gets good and may move to kingdom”. Bjorn said “Voyager of greatest voyage never keeps a small heart”, “I am there with you my friend till death”. Adonis replied with respect and gratitude “You have done all great things for me that can be done”, “But this time I want all of you to think for yourself”. Every man agrees with Bjorn and wills to travel with Adonis. Einar was being skeptical but as everyone chose glory over life he also got on the boat. The Boat man told Adonis that he has put on extra rations and clothes and some barrel of wine and rum to stay warm in the sea. Adonis thanked him and started the sail towards their next destination – Faroe Island.

A sail started with a toast of rum among the cavalry hoping the cold weather got away. The bodies of dead men were kept inside the igloos at the village to transport them back. Men were taking a moment of life to have a tipsy night. As sail was moving forward the Norskahavið sea started getting furious, half-drunk men were sailing through an angry sea chanting great verses. A heavy rain storm got in the way of boat, the skies turning darker and the wind starting to howl. The air feels charged with electricity, almost as if the sea itself is holding its breath. Heavy thunders crushing in the sky. The boat was well built and has shelter for the men but the voyage was not less than a deadly adventure. Most of the men were already sick from the cold and some more feel ill in the sea the Adonis himself was not feeling so well but still they managed to get to the Faroe Island. Faroe island is an idyllic island in the heart of a vast, sparkling ocean—a true paradise that feels like it’s straight out of a dream, it was a comfort place in middle of scary ocean. Ten of the greatest warriors arrived at the shore of Faroe Island, sick and ill. battered ship, weathered and scarred by the relentless elements, finally sights land after an arduous, perilous journey across treacherous sea. Whole crew was happy to see the land. A long sea voyage finally ended after three dark days.

poem.title: Song of Rising Sun
stanzas: A trek across harsh, unforgiving desert. Even greatest of men afraid to start. Voyager of the greatest voyage, Never keeps a small heart.
A journey through furious sea, Men toasted wine, rum and tea. With courage they crossed hell, Sobbing sea wailing eerie knell.
Faroe’s Island came to sight, Warriors had relief that night Their battered ship, found a shore. Their grueling odyssey ended in lore.

chapters.title: Iris of the Faroe Island.
chapters.summary: Discovering the ancient artifact hidden within the hollow sanctuary.

content.text: Faroe Island, as seen by the men is no less than paradise. As the island comes into view, there's a collective gasp of awe. The lush greenery, shimmering dark blue waters, and pristine dark cloudy sky, are a stark contrast to the harsh conditions endured during the journey. After arrival Adonis gave his men orders to start searching for local villages to seek some hospitality for the sick fallen men. They walked for hours and went through foggy forest. As they were walking slowly some local men spotted them and blew horns to signal their peers Adonis and his men got alerted and took positions for the retreat. A Lady with a sword with golden handle came on a horse back with a group of horsemen and women.

That was Iris the chief the local village named ‘Nólsoy’. Iris asked them “you people seem like Norge warriors”. Bjorn answered “yes, madame”. Adonis asked “and what about you?”. Iris replied “Ah, we are peasants”. Adonis exclaimed “peasants, peasants with swords and arrows?”. Iris replied “Ohh, they are for people like you”. Bjorn asked “people like us? What are you talking about girl?”. Iris replied “yes, for the safety of village from armies who seize towns for warfare”. Adonis smiled and replied “We mean no harm to your people, we are just passing by”. Iris replied smirking “Your men already looks harmed how would you harm us?”. Einar spoke out “Keep quite young lady, you are speaking before great warriors Bjorn and Prince Adonis”. Iris Smirked again and said “Oh, is that the prince adonis who defeated king Zandard ?”. Einar replied with “yes”. Iris replied “wait until your Hero meets a TRAGEDY”. Adonis said in smiling tone “ha we already met one”. Iris said with pity in her voice “I never expected to see All of you great warriors I this situation before us” and smiled looking at her horsemen. Adonis explained her the situation. Iris said “If that’s the case, I would like helping you people”. Adonis looked at his men and said “fine”.

Adonis with his men went to Nolsoy village with Iris and her men. Iris gave them shelter and provided with doctors to recover from the illness. Men were having relief. Next day Iris took Adonis and Bjorn to the old scared temple to pray for his men. After arriving at the temple gates Adonis asked Iris “Is that the place you wanted to show us?” Iris said “Its’ not a place young prince, it’s a temple you should pray for you men here before god”. Bjorn smiled and told Iris that Adonis Don’t believe in God. Iris replied “oh is it, your prince should try it once then”. Adonis said “Praying and not praying is same thing if you don’t act on it”. Iris taunted “you won’t know unless you do it”. Adonis said “okay, I’ll do it. As if it matters”. All of them prayed and went to visit the farms and fields of the village. Adonis learned about the village the whole day went roaming around the village. Adonis and Iris Became good friends even though most of their views and philosophies were contrasting. Both of them learnt new things from each other they respected each other. Adonis for the first time having such feeling of connection with someone.

At the evening hour they returned to the villa Adonis went to the men to take a look at their conditions. Men were recovering good but they needed more time to became ready for the expedition. Adonis told his men to take rest until they recover completely. Three days passed Adonis and his men were having great bond with villagers. Adonis’s men were helping villagers in work while taking hospitality form them. Adonis was helping young men in village to learn sword fighting. Iris was keeping a good eye on Adonis and his men. It was early evening a messenger eagle came by. Adonis took the message and read it. Adonis got disheartened, his breath started catching. He told the men to go home and he went to woods for some alone time. Iris saw him and followed to the woods. Adonis was sitting under a tree on a rock looking at the sunset. It was a golden evening and the golden light was passing through the trees.  The sunlight filters through the canopy, casting a dappled glow on the forest floor. And there Iris saw Adonis reading the message in grief.

Iris went to Adonis saw him in discomfort, she took the message from his hands and started reading it. The message was about his father’s declining health. Doctors wrote that his father’s condition is getting worse they might lose him. She notices his sadness and gently places a hand on his shoulder. Her touch is warm and reassuring, signaling that she’s there for him. Iris hold Adonis hand in her’s and told him “Everything will be okay”. Adonis replied “there is only one way”. “Sometimes you should let go things” Iris speaks softly. “I can’t see my father suffer and die” Adonis replied. “Those who survived sufferings, will shine among the stars” Iris said holding Adonis’s hand. Adonis looked into her eyes and said “I feel like I already lost the battle I was trying to fight”. Iris reminds him of his strength and things he has overcome in past. Adonis felt better about his situation thinking his father is not dead yet and he can help him. Iris tells him how she lost her father in a clash with a local tribe and how she managed to let those events go. Adonis said “you are so strong, emotionally”. Iris replied “you have to be strong, responsibilities teach you strength”. “I have never been this emotional around people” Adonis said with a deep breath. Iris replied “oh! so brave prince is emotional too”. “Even the heart of stone melt in heat of sorrow” Adonis replied with smile. Iris consoled him and sat with him for a while. Then Adonis said “we will be going tomorrow”. Iris exclaimed that his men are not fully recovered yet. Adonis told her that he needs to get to the Elixir as soon as possible to save this father. They both return to the village.

The night passed and the sun starts rising Adonis and Bjorn planned the further journey overnight and woke up the other men. All of the men were is good shape to travel. They gathered all of their belongings with them and made the cavalry again. Iris came with her men and gave them some extra food and essentials for the way. Iris said “promise me you’ll come back again”. Adonis replied “I don’t know how to put it into words, but I’m so grateful for everything. Your support means the world to me.” Iris said “Bye, I’ll be waiting”. Iris felt like she is losing a part of her and Adonis was feeling he is forgetting something behind. Both of them admired each other, now it was time to be separated. Cavalry started the journey towards their next adventure – The Forest of dead.

poem.title: Echoes of the Crown
stanzas: Beneath the cloudy, darkened sky, Faroe Island draws a sigh. Greenery lush and waters blue, A paradise in men’s view.
Soon they meet a troop of men, Led by a brave, bold women. Horns of warning in the air, Positions taken with great care.
Her golden sword, merciful and moral; To Adonis, she offered a welcome floral. Strangers now in bonds that tie, Together beneath that darkened sky.

chapters.title: Forest of the Dead.
chapters.summary: Navigating the dark abyss to reforge the legendary sword.

content.text: All the men were happily leaving the Nólsoy with good relations with the villagers and having a good bond. They travelled for another side of Faroe Island towards the Isle of Gardar they reached the shore and saw the peaceful sea and they mesmerized the beauty. Soon they took another big boat from the local fisherman and started their sail. The journey was peaceful and fun. Men were catching fish with the onboard nets left by fishermen and they were having all the joy of journey. They were flying the big boat on the sea, even though it was not made for fastest travel, men were giving it a single, large square sail made of heavy wool to catch the wind, propelling the boat forward at incredible speeds sooner they reached on the shores of Isle of Gadar.

They saw the beautiful Isle of Gadar and were astonished by the beauty of it, it was a green paradise and the dense dark green forests at distance were seen by Adonis and his men as the dark woolen blanket covering the Isle of Gadar. Adonis led his men towards the forest a soon as they entered the forests it was dark from inside. No sunlight was reaching the ground through the dense vegetation. Singing of birds and twinkling of fireflies was giving the feel of a dark night. As men keep walking through the forest, they started hearing strange noises and they were getting the sense of the Mephisto’s army of dead. As men walked forward the noises were getting loud and louder. Adonis and Bjorn were leading the men with courage and instantly an army of over five-hundred half dead men on horses appeared before them.

Ten of the greatest warriors were circled by the army of dead. Men were frightened but still was ready to fight till their last breath. They formed circular formation and got in the stance to take the fight with the army of dead, Mephisto appeared before them and signaled to attack. Adonis raised his sword yelled a war cry. Warriors were fighting for their life they fought furiously and attacked with full potential they were nailing it down with their swords. Adonis and Bjorn were fighting side by side killing enemy with every swing of their swords. They were showering hell on the army of dead. But sooner they realized that the men they killed were rising from dead and attacking again. Bjorn told Adonis that we can’t win this battle because the army is immortal.

Adonis realized that it’s impossible to really defeat the army of dead they keep rising from the dead. Adonis and his men were still fighting with great fury. Adonis’ men were getting wounded as they were getting tired but still, they were rising hell. Bjorn killed almost thirty men with his mighty sword and Einar was almost on record of twenty-seven. Adonis saw one of his men die and ran towards him to save but the sword of dead almost crossed his heart. Adonis was having rage and fought like a war god. He was slicing through the dead killing every dead that was in way of his sword. Bjorn noticed that some of the dead he killed were not getting back from dead. Bjorn kept fighting and realized that when he kills a dead for more than three times they wont get back. Bjorn rushed to Adonis to tell him about the secret of the dead. He saw a dead was about to land a sword on Adonis’ back he slicked that dead through the middle and was telling Adonis. “They are not really immortal” Bjorn yelled at Adonis. Adonis exclaimed “But they are not dying.”  Bjorn was about to tell him the secret but that half sliced dead came to life and poked his sword inside Bjorn from behind and Adonis Watched all this in middle of the battle, for Adonis was unable to hear anything for him the time stopped and he just took head of the dead who killed the Bjorn and picked up Bjorn. Bjorn said “They got false immortality, kill them thrice and see them disappear” as Adonis was helping him to stop the blood, trying to save him. Sadly, Bjorn died in Adoni’s arms. Adonis was so much disheartened by this and his rage increased to another level, he was now more than a god of war. He was death himself. Adonis reached to towards Mephisto and started having sword battle with him. Mephisto was a great warrior himself but Adonis was fighting like a god. The whole battle stopped to look Adonis and Mephisto fight. the sounds of their swords clinking were loud as if lighting was striking on the ground. Adonis was going furious and Mephisto had extra strength due to his mythical powers. Adonis managed to take Mephisto’s Blood out Adonis wounded him badly. Adonis yelled at Mephisto “So you are immortal?” and sliced Mephisto’s head from his body. Seeing this the men from both sides got shocked. Mephisto rose again from dead and his head grew back. He Landed a strike on Adonis but failed to harm him and Adonis again wounded him badly in battle. As men from both the sided were evidencing Adonis’ bravery, they started kneeling down to respect him. Mephisto was astonished himself seeing this amount of courage and bravery. Adonis was raining his vengeance upon him.

Adonis wounded Mephisto and kicked him down. He put his Sword against Mephisto’s neck and asked “Are you really Immortal?”, and Mephisto replied “No, it’s a curse of Immortality”. He told Adonis to let him go and he will tell him his secret and also, he will guide him through the forest to the Sönghellir cave. Adonis said in fury that you’ll do anyways and then proceeds to slash Mephisto’s head off his body. All the men saw this great battle and bowed down to Adonis and started chanting Adonis’ name. Mephisto once again got back from dead and now it’s his last life remaining. Adonis told him “I’ll let you live your last life, but you should guide every great man to the Sönghellir cave”. Mephisto agrees and guides them towards the caves the furious battle ends in a treaty.

Adonis was still in misery of his friend’s death. Scenes of Bjorn and him having good memories were playing in his mind. Adonis realized what he has lost. He was in complete grief and he told Mephisto what wrong he did. Mephisto gave his apologies to Adonis and regrated the battle. Einar said in between them “Those who doesn’t deserve Immortality, are going to die anyways”, Adonis notices the jealousy in Einar’s words but didn’t speak about it, ignores him. Adonis was in so much pain; he couldn’t forget that Bjorn gave his life for Adonis and Adonis was more for him than immortality. Adonis was thinking how selfless Bjorn was to him, how much Bjorn did for him since childhood. Adonis was deeply touched by this incident.

Mephisto alerted everyone that the caves are just miles away and they are getting closer. Einar was excited to visit the caves Adonis wanted to go back home as soon as possible. They rushed towards the cave. A messenger eagle came by and landed on shoulder of Einar. Einar took the message without letting anyone know and read the message but didn’t tell anyone about it. The caves were at their sight, they reached the entrance of the cave. Mephisto told adonis that his work is done and they have to move ahead without him and his men. Mephisto stopped him and told that he got the curse of immortality. Adonis asked him “curse of immortality?”. Mephisto and Adonis took their horses to have a talk alone and then Mephisto told Adonis that he came to Sönghellir cave with army of two thousand men all of them were human and he too was a general of that army back then. He told that only five-hundred men survived the forest and the weather. He told Adonis that they went to Herald and then Herald gave Mephisto the Secret to Immortality – Elixir. But he gave that Elixir to all his men and tried to make all of them immortal as soon as Herald noticed it. He appeared before Mephisto and cursed them with false immortality. Mephisto told Adonis that they are only given three lives and they cannot leave the dark shadow of the forest if they did so, the army will die. Adonis understood the reason behind Herald’s curse. Mephisto also told him that only one person should become immortal at once andthey have to start the journey again after receiving the Elixir. Also, Mephisto was cursed to protect the forest and the route of the Sönghellir cave. But still he helped Adonis. Both of them lost men, Mephisto was down to his four hundred men and Adonis was left with his last five men.

Adonis understood all those things and told Mephisto to go. Mephisto asked him to remember him as a good man. Adonis and his men were tired so they were staying for a while outside the caves. Admiring the magic of the dark forest. They were ready for their visit in the cave and take what they deserve – The secret of Immortality.

poem.title: Echoes of the Crown
stanzas: The Forest of Dead, Mephisto’s curse. walking through dark and worse. warriors fought with dead immortals, through bravery they opened hell’s portal.
Despite fierce fighting, lives were lost. On both the ends, one them was a good friend, Adonis’s saw his brother die, He deemed revenge and fury in his eye.
With great vengeance and flaming revenge, He brought the enemy on this blade’s edge. Nemesis begged for mercy, forgiveness. Adonis offered cold death, then recess.
Mercy was given, Mephisto was tamed. He offered his loyalty in exchange. Adonis mourned to Bjorn’s death, Mephisto gave him Aid and strength.

chapters.title: The Eclipse of Adonis
chapters.summary: The final confrontation at the heart of the sacred grove.

content.text: Six of the Norge’s Bravest warriors were standing at the mouth of Sönghellir cave, the hidden cave nestled deep within a misty forest, known as the “cave of songs and death”. Inside, the cave opens up into a vast cavern, illuminated by the soft glow of bioluminescent fungi that cast an ethereal light on the walls. Stalactites and stalagmites form natural columns, their surfaces glistening with moisture, creating a hauntingly beautiful effect.

Adonis and his men enter a cave with ode to attain Elixir for his father. Men are moving in seeing the beauty of the cave, insides of the cave are large and the walls are glowing blue. the soldiers were immediately struck by the cave's haunting beauty. They started seeing the walls of the cave were adorned with intricate carvings and ancient symbols which were illuminated by biological fungi. Soon the cave started to sing in pattern the sound of flute was getting created by the winds over small opening on the cave-top. Men started wondering about the sound it was pleasant and haunting at same time. As the men pressed on deeper into the cave, their torches casting long, wavering shadows, the atmosphere grew increasingly foreboding. The cave's intricate carvings seemed to come to life in the flickering light, their twisted forms and ancient symbols taking on an eerie, almost malevolent presence. The air was getting hotter inside as they were approaching the lava chambers. Sönghellir cave has many empty burrows and chambers some of them were large and there were three big lava chambers at the deepest end of the cave, one of those has Elixir.

Men were chatting among themselves, raising spirits among fellow men. Their Whispers echoed softly through the cavern; they were feared by their own voices. Einar sensed the fear among men. “Remember why we came here,” the Einar said, his voice steady and firm. “We've faced worse than this. Together, we've conquered every challenge thrown our way. This cave is no different”. “We're not just a team; we're a brotherhood” Adonis continued. “And no cave, no matter how dark or foreboding, can break that bond.” He added. Einar and Adonis took the lead, they were moving ahead. As Einar read the message from the eagle, he was bit off from that message but he still didn’t tell anyone about it. Einar asked Adonis “so finally we are going to get immortal?”. Adonis knew about Einar’s ambitions, he replied “Immortality, maybe we are going to die before that”. Einar asked “how so? We came this far and we are so close”. Adonis replied with smirk “Those who doesn’t deserve Immortality, are going to die anyways”. Einar realized that these same words he spoke when Bjorn died. Einar felt bad about saying it, but deep down he had ambitions to get immortal and Adonis knew that.

Einar had a vision of Elixir and he wanted to try it, he wanted to be immortal and fight the greatest wars. Little did he knew that only one person could be immortalized at once, which Adonis knew because Mephisto told him that. Einar told Adonis “We can establish peace in this world if we have elixir”. Adonis exclaimed “Really? Man of war is talking about peace?”. Einar replied “My friend, peace can be attained by men good people who can fight great wars with evil”. Adonis was amazed by this thought of Einar, “Great, but are you among those good people? Are you worthy of immortality” Adonis asked him. Einar replied “don’t you think that? I am a good person. I think I deserve it.” Adonis stopped while walking and looked into Einar’s eyes and said him “let’s see”.

They were moving slowly as the heat was increasing, and suddenly they came across the chambers of lava. Adonis and his men saw the glowing hot chambers of lava they knew that this is the deepest end of the cave. There was nothing but lava in those chambers, none of them knew what to do, “where is the secret of immortality?” one of the men asked, everyone remained quiet as nobody has answer. The walls of the chambers were illuminated by the lava on the floor. There were inscriptions on the walls, one all of them saw that and started to find meaning out of them.

The inscriptions on the walls of the lava chambers depicted a scene of both awe and mysticism. The carvings, etched with remarkable detail, revealed the story of a man standing at the edge of a molten lava pool. His expression, captured in the ancient stone, was one of determined resolve and unyielding courage. In the depiction, the man extended his hand into the seething lava. As his hand submerged deeper into the pool, the scene transitioned. Emerging from the molten depths was another figure—a mystical man, radiant and otherworldly, rising from the lava as if born from its very essence. This figure was portraying strength and wisdom.

Adonis knew what needed to be done. Looked at his men and they knew too. The Inscriptions were saying to put hand into the lava pool. Nobody from them was daring to put their hand into hot molten lava Adonis got near the edge of lava pool. Adonis smirked and said “and you think that you deserve immortality.” and puts his right hand into the hot lava. As soon as he put his hand into the lava, it started to glow bright his hands were submerged into lava he was and agonizing with pain. His face was illuminated by the glow of lava casting shadows on the walls of the chamber. Adonis yelled his mother’s name and submerged his hand even deeper. As he reached the depth of the lava pool suddenly, he felt like somebody is holding his hand. He started pulling his hand out of the pool, he pulled that being out of the pool along with his hand. The being raised and hovered above the lava pool. All the men were stunned they pulled out their swords but Adonis signaled them with his burnt hand. As soon as men saw Adonis’s right had burnt so badly that there was no flesh left and only skeleton was there but Adonis was able to move his hand like nothing has happened. Every man was surprised to look this.

The mystical being, exuding an aura of power and wisdom, gazed at Prince Adonis with eyes that seemed to hold the knowledge of countless ages. “I am Herald,” the figure announced. “Guardian of Elixir and keeper of eternal knowledge” Herald continued. “Oh so you are the one who makes people immortal” Einar asked Herald. “No, I don’t make people immortal. I give immortality to a person.” Einar exclaimed “Did I say anything different?”. “Yes, you did.” Herald told Einar. Adonis understood what Herald meant to say. Adonis told everyone that only a single person can be immortalized at a time, Elixir must be given to one person at a time. Herald said “Your prince is right”. Einar exclaimed “Prince! How do you know that he is prince?”. Herald said “I know everything, I know past and future. But I can’t change it, that’s my curse”. Adonis interrupted Herald and asked him for Elixir. Herald asked “Do you really need it?”. Adonis replied “I need it for my father”. Herald laughed and asked “King Ares? He doesn’t need it anymore” and started looking at Einar. Einar tried to hide the look of betrayal of his face but couldn’t do so. Adonis asked “why don’t he need? he is fighting death”. Herald replied “And he won, death took him with all his glory”. Adonis asked in low “what do you mean?”. Einar replied “He means King Ares is no more”. Adonis started realizing it all and yelled at Einar “how do you know?”. Einar told everything about the message, how he hides all that from the men. The message was about King Are’s death, and how ministers led coup after the throne was empty. Adonis asked him why did he do that. Einar told him how he got selfish about getting elixir and he was feared that Adonis will abandon the mission if he knew about death of his father, but know he regrets his decision, a tear drop fells off his eye and rolls down his face while saying all this. Upon hearing the devastating news of his father's death, Prince Adonis felt as if the very ground beneath him had given way. His heart, already burdened by the challenges of his quest, now bore the weight of immense grief and sorrow.

Herald still smiled and asked Adonis “you still want the secret to immortality?”. Adonis replied with anger in his eyes “After coming this far, I won’t go empty handed”. Herald’s felt that his knowledge is incomplete for the first time, because of Adonis’s choice of still taking the elixir. He asked herald to bring him Elixir. Herald summoned the vessel of Elixir into his hands and gave it to Adonis. Adonis took that glowing vessel took a gaze into it, the liquid was shiny multicolored though and glowing incandescently. Adoni’s men wanted to be immortal too, but herald told them about the curse if they all took the elixir. So, no men dared to ask for the elixir from Adonis. Adonis said “Is immortality worth it? After losing everything?”. A strict silence was observed. Adonis said “you want immortality, Take it from me.” Adonins approached to the near cave rock and sat on it he looked in Einar’s eyes and slowly started pouring Elixir on his on foot. His eyes gleam with arrogance, a clear message that he believes himself above the need for eternal life. Around him, his men and subjects watch in shock and awe, their faces a mix of confusion and disbelief at his display of egotism. Every one of them was in shock even Herald didn’t expect this to happen and Einar’s Ego shattered into pieces. He knew what Adonis meant to say, soon he ran towards Adonis and started licking his foot. Adonis was smiling as he showed them all, the worth of elixir. Einar was ambitious and visionary, he kept his ego aside, he knew Adonis will never drink the Elixir himself. Adonis emptied the vessel on his foot and Einar licked all of it, and Herald said in his majestic voice “Now I pronounce you as ‘King Adonis -The Great’”. Everyone bowed before Adonis. Einar said “My King Adonis, I’ll be your loyal servant till my death” and all of the men took oath of loyalty.

Herald praised Adonis saying “Adonis, the son of great king Ares, you have attained immortality through your deeds”. “Your legend will be remembered through Ages.” Herald added. “The man who neglected the decision of gods and became great, the king who keeps immortality to his feet” Einar continued with Herald. All men started chanting Adonis’ name. The quest ends after many days of struggle. Einar became Immortal, Adonis Became great. Men learnt a life lesson.

After this great event, they came to know that the ministers led a coup in the kingdom and they need to bring the kingdom together. They fought the great battle to attain their kingdom back; Adonis became the greatest king of Norge. After having the immortal Einar as his army general they fought many great wars and established kingdom of peace and welfare. Einar stayed as loyal servant to king Adonis. King Adonis’s legacy was one of love, compassion, and unwavering dedication to the greater good. The story of his reign inspired future generations to strive for the same ideals of selflessness and goodwill.

events.title: The Fall of Eldoria
events.description: The catastrophic event that bound the forest in perpetual twilight, caused by the arrogance of the first kings who sought to tame the ancient roots.

events.title: Forging of the Ember Blade
events.description: Crafted from star-fall ore in the deep subterranean fires, this blade was shattered to prevent it from falling into the hands of the Shadow.

events.title: The Sealing of the Sanctuary
events.description: The last pure mages of the realm locked the Crown of the Fallen inside the Hollow Sanctuary, awaiting a true heir.

relics.name: The Vessel of Elixir
relics.description: A glowing vessel obtained from Herald in the deepest lava chambers of Sönghellir cave. It contains the shimmering liquid of immortality, which Adonis poured onto his own foot to shatter Einar's ego and prove his greatness.

relics.name: The Sacred Flower of Swēoland
relics.description: A delicate bloom brought back from Adonis's victorious seventh battle. He left it resting on King Ares's pillow as a silent, heartbreaking farewell before venturing into the deadly cold of Norge.

relics.name: The Royal Treasury Map
relics.description: An ancient parchment stolen from the deepest vaults of Norge. It charts the treacherous, agonizing path through the mourning Norskahavið sea to the hidden Isle of Garðar.

relics.name: Bjorn's Fallen Blade
relics.description: The mighty sword of Bjorn, which sliced through almost thirty cursed soldiers in the Forest of the Dead before his tragic demise. It stands as the ultimate symbol of brotherhood, loyalty, and sacrifice.

relics.name: Iris's Golden-Hilted Sword
relics.description: The regal blade carried by Iris, Chief of Nólsoy on the Faroe Island. It represents the fierce protection of her village and the deep, emotional bond of understanding she formed with the weary Prince Adonis.

relics.name: Mephisto's Cursed Steel
relics.description: The weapon wielded by the immortal general of the dead army. It clashed against Adonis's sword like striking lightning before its master was brought to his knees and forced to guide the Norge warriors.

relics.name: Spores of Sönghellir
relics.description: Bioluminescent fungi harvested from the eerie depths of the singing cave. They cast a haunting, ethereal blue glow and resonate with the mystical flute-like winds of the underground abyss.
